# Heitor Mobílio — Executive Career Experience

> Executive "CV as a website" for Heitor Mobílio, a Finance, Strategy and Planning leader (FP&A) with a track record across digital-first companies: Serasa, iFood, Porto/Olho Mágico, Rappi, VOLL and Decolar. Positioning: on the frontier between strategy and execution.

This site presents a real executive profile in three languages (English, Portuguese, Spanish; client-side language switch, requires JavaScript). Sections: Who I Am, Career (with an impact timeline and six company cases), How I Think (six mental models), Career Inflection Points (four moments), Recommendations (real LinkedIn testimonials), and Let's Talk (contact).
